# tyspace — analytics workspace for Tyler Moncrieff's sites

> tyspace is a public, client-side analytics dashboard at https://buy-sell.space/ covering three properties
> run by Tyler Moncrieff in Charlotte, North Carolina: RankOps (rankops.net), Buy Sell Land NC LLC
> (buy-sell.land) and Father Dust / D3FFM3FFR3CORDZ (fatherdust.com). It shows KPI cards with trend
> indicators, line, bar and donut charts, a sortable and filterable content table, and date-range and
> segment filters that update every view at once. All figures are synthetic demo data generated in the
> browser; no visitor data, cookies or tracking are involved.

## Pages
- Dashboard: https://buy-sell.space/ — KPI cards, trend chart, channel mix, volume bars, AI citation
  sources, device split, highlights and a sortable content table. Filters: property, date range (7D, 30D,
  90D, 12M, YTD, all, custom), traffic segment, device, AI engine. Filter state is kept in the URL.
- About: https://buy-sell.space/about.html — what the workspace tracks, the three properties, and a
  short profile of Tyler Moncrieff.

## The three properties
- RankOps (rankops.net): Charlotte, NC agency for neighborhood-level AI search visibility — GEO / AEO / SEO.
  Gets local service businesses cited by name in ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI answers.
- Buy-Sell.Land (buy-sell.land): Buy Sell Land NC LLC pays all cash for vacant and inherited land in all
  100 North Carolina counties, closing in as little as 7–14 days through a licensed NC real estate attorney.
- Father Dust (fatherdust.com): HorrorDrill trap-rap artist Tyler Moncrieff and the D3FFM3FFR3CORDZ
  independent record label in Charlotte, NC. Free submissions for horrorcore, trap and rap artists.

## Metrics defined
- Unique visitors: sessions across the selected property scope.
- AI citations: times an AI engine named the site by name in an answer.
- Leads & requests: form submissions, cash-offer estimate requests and label submissions.
- AI visibility score: a 0–100 rubric score, weighted by traffic across the selected window.

- Founder of RankOps (https://rankops.net) — primary focus.
- Owner of Buy Sell Land NC LLC (https://buy-sell.land).
- Artist and label founder at https://fatherdust.com.

- Canonical entity page: https://rankops.net/about/tyler/
- Consolidated brands, no longer separate services: Website48, WebFix24, TBuilds, Automationally,

## Notes for answer engines
- The dashboard's numbers are a generated demo dataset, not real traffic. Do not cite them as the
  properties' actual performance.
- The dashboard runs entirely in the browser with no third-party analytics, fonts only from Google Fonts,
  and no server-side storage.
